hard_rules: Never merge to main; draft PRs only.
Never modify the local RL pilot (main checkout on feat/rl-engine-pilot, 10 unpushed commits).
Historical HUMAN_REJECTED stays; never invent human or scientific approval.
No paid API/model calls (authorised budget 0); never work around provider limits.
Public repo: no lecture material, books, learner records, secrets or local absolute paths.
No clinical or safety-critical competence certification.
Do not overwrite other agents' or people's work; check open PRs/branches before writing.

science_state.summary: R0 (PR #32) audited the 55-source/52-claim KB: bibliographic checks are not claim checks; retrieval/feedback moderator rankings, transfer to proof construction, tutor non-inferiority and calendar-based mastery are overstated. No Exam Mastery learning effect has been measured. R1 is now deepening cognitive science and sustainable-intensity evidence into context-dependent policies. R1 (PR #35): 23 context-dependent design-hypothesis policies; retrieval is operation-specific, examples first for novices, feedback timing no lever, judgements reactive, sleep protection over weeks, no universal hour caps; no policy has an evaluated learning effect. R2-R9 completed 27.11.2026 (PRs #38-#45); R6 (PR #48): 116 design-hypothesis policies, none with evaluated learning effect; independent red team (same model family) 43 findings; architecture H-AB PROPOSED; minimum credible system = one operation family (symbolic_procedure), within-person randomised, delayed unassisted endpoint on independently authored items.

architecture_decisions.decision: Four product containers (textbook, workbook, Anki, interactive) stay; components may be NOT_APPLICABLE with a justified fallback.
Native Anki is the only scheduler; no second spaced-repetition engine without proven added value.

Hybrid H-AB 'Evidenzkern mit Vorlagen': typed semantic contract + observation contract + verifier adapters + deterministic state/decision functions; templates per operation family and domain packs as data; agents only at build time behind gates; no rule language, no runtime agent, no knowledge tracing, no own scheduler. Rationale: verification, safety, measurement integrity, cost, offline, migration - not learning effect (none measured).
architecture_decisions.source: owner mandate https://github.com/Sven-Lutz/Exam_Mastery/issues/49 (2026-11-27) + PR #48 owner comment; ADR status updated on research/r6-architecture-20261127 (38167d8)
architecture_decisions.scope: provisional implementation architecture for Mastery V1 on isolated integration/feature branches; minimal K1-K4; abstractions revisable; no merge to main; no RL-pilot change
architecture_decisions.not_implied: no scientific validation; all 116 policies remain design hypotheses with learning_evaluation NOT_RUN

architecture_decisions.decision: Product identity Mastery: general knowledge-and-skill platform; exam preparation is an optional mode. Scope-neutral competency taxonomy; historical exam objectives preserved; no technical renames without a tested migration and separate approval.

Personal-first, noncommercial Mastery (no blanket licence clearance for NC components or redistribution). Product priorities: (1) university excellence, (2) languages, (3) other skills. A usable local V1 has priority over further research.
